newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank plans new shares, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank plans new shares, bonds.

text.p: Thai Military Bank Plc said on Wednesday that it planned to issue 186,792,400 shares at 10 baht each as part of a plan to boost capital.

In a filing to the Thai stock exchange, the bank said that it also planned to issue up to 6.0 billion baht in long-term subordinate debentures and/or subordinate convertible debentures with warrants in local and/or foreign markets.
Thai Military Bank said 60 million of its planned new shares would be reserved for future conversion by its debenture holders and the rest allocated to shareholders on terms to be specified later.
It said proceeds from the new share floatation and issues of debentures with maturities of up to 30 years would be used for the bank's lending programme.
The planned debentures and new shares will raise the bank's capital to seven billion baht from 5.13 billion.
